categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Copper Company Limited operates primarily in two segments: the production and sale of copper and related products, and the production and sale of gold and related products. The company also engages in mining, dressing, smelting, processing of non-ferrous metals, extraction and processing of rare and scattered metals, sulphuric chemistry, and trading activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs pyrometallurgical smelting for copper production, which involves melting smelting and electrolytic refining, suitable for high-grade copper sulphide ores. Wet smelting is used for gold smelting. It also uses advanced technologies such as flash smelting, intelligent mining systems, and digital transformation initiatives including Internet of Things and artificial intelligence in mining and smelting processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include copper processing enterprises, industrial users in electrical, electronics, light industry, machinery manufacturing, construction, transportation, and national defense sectors. Gold and silver products are sold through national exchanges like the Shanghai Gold Exchange and exported to regions including Hong Kong, South Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia. Sulphuric acid is supplied mainly to chemical and fertilizer industries in various regions of China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, with significant assets and operations in Jiangxi Province and other provinces such as Shandong. It also has overseas investments and operations in countries including Canada, Kazakhstan, Mexico, South America, Africa, Afghanistan, Peru, Zambia, Albania, and Tajikistan. Sales markets include Eastern, Southern, and Northern China, Hong Kong, and international markets in Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Copper Company Limited operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the copper and precious metals supply chain. It controls mining operations (upstream), smelting and refining (midstream), and copper product processing and sales (downstream), establishing a fully integrated industrial chain from exploration to final product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-quality development, technological innovation, and digital transformation. Key R&D initiatives include resource utilization of low-grade ores, green beneficiation reagents, extraction of rare and scattered metals, and development of intelligent mining and smelting technologies. It also emphasizes overseas resource acquisition and strategic partnerships, as well as environmental sustainability and carbon reduction technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of copper cathode, gold, silver, sulphuric acid, copper rods, wires, and other processed copper products. Sales are conducted via direct sales, long-term contracts, spot and futures trading on exchanges such as the Shanghai Futures Exchange and Shanghai Gold Exchange, and exports to international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangxi Copper is the largest copper cathode producer in China and a leading integrated copper and precious metals producer. It holds a dominant market position with significant resource reserves and advanced technology. Competitors include other large domestic and international copper producers and smelters, but Jiangxi Copper leverages scale, technology, and brand advantages to maintain leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately RMB 520 billion in 2024 with a slight year-on-year decrease of 0.18%, while net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 7.03% to about RMB 6.96 billion. Total assets grew by 14.85% to RMB 193 billion, and net assets increased by 15.61% to RMB 77.9 billion. The company maintains a gearing ratio of 54.54%, reflecting a large-scale enterprise with steady growth and strong financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangxi Copper offers a complete integrated industrial chain from mining to processing, providing high-quality copper cathode, gold, and silver products registered with international exchanges like LME and LBMA. Its scale, advanced technology, cost advantages, and strong brand recognition differentiate it in the market. The company emphasizes innovation, environmental sustainability, and digital transformation to enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and competitive advantage.
